name: server
required_capabilities: native Io fibers and TLS SDK; a PostgreSQL server from tests/start_server.sh, else skipped

name: migrate
required_capabilities: native Io fibers; a PostgreSQL server from tests/start_server.sh for the database part

name: managed
required_capabilities: native Io fibers; JAI_PG_TEST_MANAGED=1 also downloads PostgreSQL (curl and tar) and starts a server

name: conformance/pipeline_traces
required_capabilities: native Io fibers; a PostgreSQL server and libpq_pipeline's traces (tools/pg_conformance/run.py --pipeline-traces), else skipped
